info.title: OrderService API
info.description: Order Service API for order processing, checkout, order tracking, and cart management in the ECommerce system.

get.summary: Retrieves the current authenticated user's shopping cart.

post.summary: Adds a product item to the user's shopping cart.

requestBody.description: Product identifier and quantity to add.

put.summary: Updates the quantity of a specific item in the shopping cart.

400.description: Invalid quantity or business rule violation.

delete.summary: Removes a specific item from the shopping cart.

post.summary: Creates a new customer order from checkout with idempotency protection.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique idempotency key header to prevent duplicate orders.

requestBody.description: Order checkout details including shipping address and items.

400.description: Missing Idempotency-Key header or invalid order data.

get.summary: Retrieves all orders belonging to the authenticated customer.
Retrieves order details by order identifier. Customers may view only their own orders; Admins may view any order.

404.description: Order not found or access denied.

get.summary: Retrieves all orders for a specific user ID. Requires Admin role.

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

put.summary: Updates the status of an order. Requires Admin role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: New order status numeric value (0: Pending, 1: Confirmed, 2: Processing, 3: Shipped, 4: Delivered, 5: Cancelled).

403.description: User does not possess Admin role.

post.summary: Cancels a pending order and initiates compensating refund and inventory release.

400.description: Order cannot be cancelled in its current state.

post.summary: Marks an order as successfully paid upon receipt of payment confirmation from PaymentService. Internal endpoint.

parameters.name: X-Internal-Service-Key
parameters.description: Secret key required for authenticating internal inter-service requests.

200.description: Order successfully updated to Paid status.

400.description: Order cannot transition to Paid state.

AddToCartDto.description: Request payload for adding an item to the shopping cart.

items.description: Collection of items currently stored in the cart.

CartDto.description: Represents a customer's active shopping cart and its contents.

CartItemDto.description: Item stored in a customer's shopping cart.

shippingAddressLine2.description: Street address line 2 (optional apartment, suite, unit).

shippingPhoneNumber.description: Recipient phone number for delivery updates.

CreateOrderDto.description: Checkout request payload containing shipping destination information. Cart items are converted automatically.

userId.description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order.

status.description: Current numeric status of the order (0: Pending, 1: Confirmed, 2: Processing, 3: Shipped, 4: Delivered, 5: Cancelled).

totalAmount.description: Total monetary amount for the order.

shippingAddressLine2.description: Street address line 2, apartment or suite.

items.description: Line items included in the order.

OrderDto.description: Order details returned for customer order history and administrative order review.

productName.description: Snapshot of product name at time of order creation.

OrderItemDto.description: Line item representing a purchased product within an order.

quantity.description: New item quantity (must be between 1 and 100).

UpdateCartItemQuantityDto.description: Request payload for updating the quantity of an item in the cart.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Enter your JWT token directly.
